description.en: Plugins maintained by Guozifan7 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Guozifan7 维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Rotates real-time A-share quotes in the title bar; hover for every monitored quote plus industry boards, click a row for a Tonghuashun-style intraday chart. Name search, refresh rate, rotation interval and docked corner in Settings.
description.zh: 在界面标题栏竖向轮播 A 股实时行情，悬浮展开全部行情与行业指数，点个股看同花顺式盘中分时图；支持名称搜索、刷新频率、轮播间隔与停靠角落设置。
